lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete, high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately four discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs show a regular spatial distribution with larger diameters located along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the centers of the circular high-luminance blobs to create a rectilinear grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and lower luminance (shadow) on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, well-defined semi-circular notch or tissue excision is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A transition in spot morphology is visible where high-density, smaller, irregular clusters anterior to the gill slits give way to larger, more sparse circular spots on the posterior flank.
